scope: Offline source-authority and row-citation audit of the repository state; no external URLs fetched.
limitations: This run does not fetch or re-open NFL/club pages. Links are provided for manual review; availability and page contents may change.
An approved hostname proves only the publisher domain, not that a linked page supports the specific claim or that the extracted row is parsed correctly.
SHA-256 checksums support byte-integrity comparisons only; they do not prove NFL authorship, truth, license, or currentness.
The static club-domain map is a review aid based on the official NFL team directory URL in catalog source S05; verify it again when updating the map.

The historical snapshot timestamp is not a live injury/depth feed or a guarantee about current lineups; this HTML/report is generated from the checked-in snapshot and is not refreshed automatically by the Pages deployment capture step.
No odds/proposition ledger, validated strategy edge, empirical parlay correlation, or funded reward result is established by this audit.

findings.title: Source-host checks are not independent of the data being checked
findings.detail: `official_hosts(snapshot)` adds hosts from `depth_rows` and `depth_directory_successes`; `verify_lab()` then accepts a depth row when its host is in that same set. A synthetic `untrusted.invalid` host is admitted. Separately, `capture_official.py` adopts matching hostnames from the team-directory HTML and creates its redirect allowlist from the discovered hostname; a synthetic directory entry was accepted. Add a static 32-club host map before either gate. These are verifier design gaps, not evidence that current club hosts are malicious.

findings.title: The depth-row check does not require HTTPS
findings.detail: The existing depth-row gate compares only `urlparse(source_url).hostname` against an allowlist; an HTTP URL on an allowed hostname passes that part of the check. The independent fixed allowlist rejects HTTP.

findings.title: The broad repo audit can treat unrelated GitHub repositories as official
findings.detail: `github.com` is in the broad `EXTRA_OFFICIAL` host set, while `is_community()` only excludes two nflverse path prefixes. A test URL under an unrelated GitHub owner is therefore eligible to count as an official table citation. GitHub hosting/digests establish neither NFL authorship nor NFL factual authority.

findings.title: Many repository table rows still lack a link to an approved primary-source host
findings.detail: The independent fixed-host scanner counted 530 such rows among 3626 `<tbody>` rows on 77 HTML pages. This is a host-level count only; it does not judge whether a link's content supports its row. See `pages_with_missing_primary_links` in `report.json` for a per-page breakdown.
